title: Metropolis–Hastings as a named MCMC kernel
dek: Wikipedia MH: propose, accept with min(1, ratio). Diagnostics stay on stats-mcmc. Not a posterior by itself.
story: Metropolis–Hastings on Wikipedia is a kernel: from θ, propose θ', accept with probability min(1, [p(θ')q(θ|θ')] / [p(θ)q(θ'|θ)]). The chain's stationary law is the target posterior if you ran it forever and the kernel connects the space.
stats-mcmc already owns ESS, R̂, and divergences. This card is the named kernel so 'we used MCMC' can mean MH versus Gibbs versus HMC.
A pretty trace plot is not a proof of stationarity.
deep: Random-walk MH on a badly scaled posterior crawls. Reparameterise.
Gibbs is MH with proposals that are exact full conditionals (acceptance 1).
HMC uses gradients (wiki-hmc if present; stats-mcmc otherwise).
Do not thin as a substitute for running longer without a storage reason.

visual.caption: Kernel loop. Stationarity is a theorem about the infinite run; diagnostics are stats-mcmc.
